format: Head-to-Head Points, 14 teams, 14-week regular season, 8-team playoff
source: Fantrax League Rules Summary, scraped read-only by Eddie on 2026-09-28 (/workspace/fantrax-pending-claims-score-2026-09-28.json -> scoringFull + lineup). Written to this file 2026-10-09.
verifiedAgainst: Checked against Fantrax season FPts on 2026-09-28: DeForest Buckner (3 GP) 60 shown vs ~57-60 recomputed; Brian Robinson Jr. 36 shown vs ~37 recomputed (bonuses are applied per scoring period, rounded down).
reverifyWhen: Re-scrape the League Rules Summary if the commissioner announces a rules change, or before the playoffs (Week 15).

season.scoringPeriod: Thursday to Wednesday PT. Fantrax Week 5 = Oct 8-14, 2026.
season.weekFormula: week = 1 + floor((today_PT - 2026-09-10) / 7 days). Cross-check against the Fantrax matchup header.
season.targetWeekRule: Report on the current week until its Monday night game ends. From Tuesday on, report on next week (waivers process Wednesday).
season.statFreeze: Official stat corrections stop counting after 8 PM ET Wednesday.

faab.note: A 2026-09-28 scrape showed claimBudget 100, but faab.json and the earlier reports say $115. Treat $115 as correct and recheck on Fantrax if it matters.
faab.waiverProcessing: Wednesday 9:00 AM PT (seen Sep 30 and Oct 7). Fantrax also showed a Friday 9:30 AM PT run for Oct 9. Read the actual next process time from Fantrax every run.

roster.notes: 7 offensive starters and 7 IDP starters, with no K and no team DST. Flex players are scored by their actual position. Players score in every stat group (so an offensive player's KR/PR counts).

passing.passYardBonus: +6 per 100 yds counted in the 200-600 band (as written on Fantrax; read as +6 at 300, 400, 500 and 600)

rushing.carryBonus: +1 per 7 rush attempts, counted from 0 to 50 (max +7)

returns.note: Return yards count for every player, so a KR/PR job adds a real floor.

idp.tackleBonus: +3 per 5 total tackles (solo + assisted), counted from 0 to 40
idp.sack: 3 per 0.5 sack (6 per full sack), counted from 0 to 15
idp.note: No separate IDP fumble-recovery count; in the Buckner check an FR seems to have scored 3 through the default group. LB, DB and DL share the same scoring except DL pass defenses (4).

implications: IDP is about half of every score: Eddies W4 had 131 IDP points vs 95 offense. Weigh IDP waivers as heavily as offense.
Tackle volume is king: 7 solo + 3 ast = 17 + 6 bonus = 23. Every-down LBs and box safeties with 8+ tackles beat boom-bust edge rushers.
Sacks are 6, TFL 3 and QB hits 1, so a pass rusher only matters if he has real snap share AND a pressure rate. DL pass defenses score 4.
TE premium is heavy: a TE line of 6-70 is ~18 (9 + 7 + ~2 first downs) vs ~13 for a WR with the same line. Start TEs in the RWT flex.
The 100-yard bonuses (+6 each 100 rush or rec yds) reward big-play and high-volume players. Weekly ceiling matters.
The carry bonus (+1 per 7) favors 14-20 carry workhorses over committee change-of-pace backs.
KR/PR yards score for anyone, so a returner role adds a ~3-6 pt floor.
Passing pays 0.04/yd, 6-pt TDs and -3 per INT, plus +6 bonuses from 300 yds. Only 1 QB starts, so QB streaming matters less than RB/TE/IDP volume.
